name: Shanghai MicroPort EP MedTech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai MicroPort EP MedTech Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of medical devices in the field of electrophysiological interventional diagnosis and ablation therapy in China and internationally. The company offers cardiac ablation catheters, diagnostic catheters, and system navigational solutions; access conventional solutions; cryoablation solutions; and robotic magnetic navigation solutions. It also exports its products to France, Italy, Bulgaria, Brazil, and Thailand.
